dev.reason: Develop environment auto-seeds essential data (roles). Developers can manually run additional seeders as needed.
manualSeedCommands: npm run seed:roles       # Essential - creates District Admin and Educator roles
npm run seed:schools     # Optional - adds sample schools
npm run seed:educators   # Optional - adds sample educators

qa.reason: QA environment seeds only essential roles. QA team creates test data via API/UI for realistic testing.
qa.notes: Avoid pre-seeded students/classes to ensure QA tests data creation workflows

prod.reason: Production environment seeds ONLY essential roles. All production data must be created via proper admin workflows.
warnings: DO NOT use truncate on production
Only roles seeder should run automatically
